guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：資料庫交易與日誌
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Database transactions and logging
guides.concept: 以ACID、MVCC 與可復原日誌連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect acid, mvcc and recoverable logging through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ACID 分離」的資料、控制與時間關係。原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「異常分類」的資料、控制與時間關係。髒讀、不可重複讀與幻讀不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用兩會話紙上時序分類。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Serializable」的資料、控制與時間關係。序列化失敗可能需要整個交易重試。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立不重複副作用的重試。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「提交確認」的資料、控制與時間關係。成功確認需符合選定耐久政策。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同步與非同步承諾。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「崩潰重播」的資料、控制與時間關係。重播需處理已提交及未完成狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「枚舉不同崩潰位置。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「不變量驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acid separation. Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map fictional failures to properties. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for anomaly classification. Dirty, nonrepeatable and phantom reads differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify paper traces of two sessions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for serializable. Serialization failures may require whole-transaction retries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Design retries without duplicate side effects. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for commit acknowledgment. Acknowledgment follows selected durability policy. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare synchronous/asynchronous promises. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for crash replay. Replay handles committed and unfinished state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate crash points. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for invariant acceptance. Commit success does not establish business invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check balance conservation and uniqueness. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「清理版本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較長快照與清理積壓。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「不變量驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。」。
提交「不變量驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit version cleanup input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit invariant acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit invariant acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.
